types.name: AIBillingMode
types.description: How an audience pays for AI on AudienceKit's keys (AiBillingAccount, doc/AI_USAGE.md).

enumValues.name: INVOICE
enumValues.description: Allowance enforced; invoiced monthly through Stripe's AI meter once invoicing is set up.

enumValues.name: COMP
enumValues.description: On the house: no allowance, never billed.

enumValues.name: DEMO
enumValues.description: A demo or trial: allowance enforced, never billed.

enumValues.name: REVENUE
enumValues.description: Covered by other revenue it brings in, such as ads: allowance enforced, not invoiced.

types.name: AdvertisingMode
types.description: How much paid placement an audience's apps carry, from none to traditional ads. See doc/ADVERTISING.md.

enumValues.name: AD_FREE
enumValues.description: None: no promoted or sponsored cards. Only AudienceKit's own cards, free charity cards and the audience's announcements show. adFreeSponsor names who pays for it.

enumValues.name: SPONSORSHIPS
enumValues.description: Sponsorships only: its own venues and events can be placed higher, labelled Sponsored and never targeted or tracked; nothing from outside, and its admins book them (venues can't buy their own).

enumValues.name: OPEN
enumValues.description: Privacy-protected ads: venues, events and local sponsors can book promoted cards, shown labelled, contextually, at a flat rate and in fair rotation.

enumValues.name: TRADITIONAL
enumValues.description: Traditional ads. For now the same as OPEN: ad-network delivery isn't built.

types.name: AgeCheck
types.description: The proof of age members in the United Kingdom and Australia need. Report the store country first (reportStoreCountry), show `explainer`, then let them pick one of `methodsOffered`. A free one starts right away (startAgeCheck with its method). The paid one: sell one of `productIds`, send the purchase (recordAgeCheckPurchase), then open the check (startAgeCheck).

fields.name: refundUrl

types.name: Appearance

fields.name: durationMinutes
fields.description: endTiming DURATION: how long it runs once on.

fields.description: How long it is expected to run: its set length, else an act's scenes or tracks plus other time; null when nothing says.

fields.name: event
fields.description: The event whose lineup it's on, built ahead; null for one on the venue night's own lineup.

fields.name: extraMinutes
fields.description: An act: time beyond its scenes or tracks, as set; null for the default (10 minutes).

fields.name: flexible
fields.description: Whether it stretches or shrinks to bring the show back on time.

fields.name: id

fields.name: lateMinutes
fields.description: How many minutes after its set time it starts, as projected (negative: early); null without a set time.

fields.name: lineup
fields.description: The lineup it's on (doc/LINEUP_MODEL.md): a zone's night or an event's in a zone.

fields.name: maxMinutes
fields.description: The longest it runs when it flexes, as set.

fields.name: mediaItem
fields.description: Activity WATCH: the episode or film the room watches.

fields.name: mediaPlaylist
fields.description: Activity SING_ALONG: the audience's media playlist it sings, its songs as its scenes; WATCH: the series.

fields.name: minMinutes
fields.description: The shortest it runs when it flexes, as set.

enumValues.description: No difference: every song is shuffled together.

enumValues.name: DPP
enumValues.description: Pick a set of songs spread out from each other (a determinantal point process), place it in random order, repeat.

enumValues.name: DOWNGRADE
enumValues.description: Take a lighter action than Glam suggested.

enumValues.name: OVERTURN
enumValues.description: Glam was wrong: nobody is acted on unless an action is given. Silent; a nudge (or, with retract, a reply) is taken down.

enumValues.name: ESCALATE
enumValues.description: Send it to a human moderator.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AppReviewCodeAdd

fields.name: addEventPhoto
fields.description: Adds a photo taken with the app's camera at a venue (only while the app places you there): it's marked AMATEUR, credited to you, put on the event under way there, and tagged with whoever is on stage, so it shows on the venue's, the event's and their pages (IPosts.photos).

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EventPhotoTake

fields.name: addLineupTask

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for LineupTaskAdd

fields.description: Links a local guide (a city's LGBTQ+ guide, a nightlife listing, a community calendar) to one of the audience's locales. Research reads a locale's guides first when it looks for venues and events there. Adding a link it already has updates its title and note.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for LocaleGuideAdd

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PersonHeadshotAdd

fields.description: Grants a photographer's hedonism_bot account access to the audience: their photos may be shown here, credited to them, in the metros chosen. Photos themselves arrive by pull over the photography provider contract (connectPhotographer), so no token is issued.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PhotographerAdd

args.name: input

args.description: Parameters for RoomChecklistItemAdd

args.description: Parameters for VenueBannerPhotoAdd

args.description: Parameters for LineupAdvance

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for BrandingConfigApply

args.description: Parameters for McpConnectionApprove

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for OnboardingInviteApprove

args.description: Parameters for VenueDevicePairingApprove

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for BlockedUserAdd

fields.name: bookPromoPlacement

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PromoPlacementBook

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for CoatCheckBuy

fields.description: Starts paying tonight's cover at a venue, through the venue's provider. Stripe: finish the payment with Stripe's payment sheet (paymentIntentClientSecret, on the venue's account stripeAccountId, with publishableKey), then call confirmCover. Square: make a payment token with Square's In-App Payments SDK (squareApplicationId, squareLocationId), then call payCover with it. Asking again the same night returns the same pass.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for CoverBuy

fields.description: Cancels a pairing at any point: neither of you sees the other from then on. Cancelling your pairing takes you out of Quickie for tonight (your partner looks for someone new); a bonus topic just ends.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PairUpCancel

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for RSVPCancel

fields.name: cancelSafetyAlert

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for SafetyAlertCancel

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for GuestPurchasesClaim

fields.name: clearChatRoom

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for CoverNightClear

With `subjectId` it joins that venue or performer; without one (`app`, and `localeId` for a venue) the invitee adds their own venue or performer page and owns it. Show `invite.url` as a QR code; the code is also in `invite.code`.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for OnboardingInviteCreate

fields.name: createPerson

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PersonCreate

fields.name: createPost
fields.description: Posts as a venue on the venue, one of its events or one of its series; or, with asPersonId, as a person (talent) on their own page or an event they're on. Name exactly one of venueId, eventId, eventSeriesId and personId.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PostCreate

fields.name: createPostComment
fields.description: Comments on a venue's or a person's post, as the signed-in user. Someone banned from the venue's chat can't, and nobody can once its comments are closed.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PostCommentCreate

fields.name: createStaffAssignment
fields.description: Puts someone on a show's support staff: person X in role Y, e.g. Rick Mark on photography. An event's hosts add to its show only (eventId).

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for StaffAssignmentCreate

fields.name: createStageZone
fields.description: Adds a zone to a venue ("+ Add zone"), e.g. the patio: it runs its own night lineup.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for StageZoneCreate

fields.name: createTag
fields.description: Adds a tag to the audience's list.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for TagCreate

fields.name: createTaskTemplate
fields.description: Adds a lineup task template to a venue, event series, event or performer (a troupe too), at the end: every lineup entry it applies to gets the task. Name exactly one owner.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for TaskTemplateCreate

fields.name: createVenue
fields.description: Adds a venue to the audience: a bar, club or other place that holds events.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueCreate

fields.name: cueLineup
fields.description: Moves a show along (doc/LINEUP_MODEL.md). On a zone's night lineup it moves the show on in the zone: an event's while it's on, else the night's own. ADVANCE starts the show (the host comes on), puts on the next scene, ends a scene (back to the host, or on to the next scene), ends the show when nothing is left (an event goes to postshow) and leaves postshow. BACK undoes the last change; END ends the show now.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for LineupCue

fields.name: decideEvaluation
fields.description: Decides a decision in the decision queue with one of its options. `note` is the reason, which some options need (rejecting a suggestion).

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for DecisionDecide

fields.name: decideSubmission
fields.description: Decides a suggestion in the review queue: APPROVE applies it, EDIT_APPROVE applies `proposed` instead, REJECT needs a reason (badFaith also lowers the submitter’s trust), NEEDS_VENUE asks the venue's staff to confirm it.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for SubmissionDecide

fields.name: declineOnboardingInvite
fields.description: Declines an ownership request. Nothing was granted; the invite ends.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for OnboardingInviteDecline

fields.name: deleteAccount
fields.description: Deletes the signed-in user's account in this audience: their membership and everything they did here (see AudienceMemberEraser), and signs them out of this audience's apps. Their accounts in other audiences stay; when this was their last one, the whole account goes (UserDataEraser). It can't be undone.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AccountDelete

fields.name: deleteAppearance

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ArbiterPromptDelete

args.name: input

args.name: input

fields.name: deleteCalendarFeed

args.name: input

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PersonOfficeDelete

args.description: Parameters for PostDelete

args.description: Parameters for PromoPlacementDelete

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for StaffAssignmentDelete

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for StageZoneDelete

fields.name: deleteTaskTemplate

args.name: input

fields.name: deleteTriviaSet
fields.description: Deletes one of the audience's own trivia sets. Segments set to it pick one by their tags again; rounds that ran keep their tallies.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for TriviaSetDelete

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueDisplayDelete

fields.name: deleteVenueDisplayGroup

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueDisplayGroupDelete

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueMusicLicenseDelete

args.description: Parameters for VenueSlideshowDelete

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for WatchPartyDelete

args.description: Parameters for ContactMatchingDisable

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for TicketingAccountDisconnect

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueOrderingDisconnect

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenuePaymentsDisconnect

fields.description: Disconnects a venue's own Spotify account and forgets its tokens. Its nights' playlists are then read with the performers' or the audience's account, when one can.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueSpotifyDisconnect

args.name: input

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PublicationAdsEnable

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PingEnd

args.description: Parameters for ShowEnd

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for StaffLiveActivityEnd

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ContentReportEscalate

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EvaluationFail

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ArticleFeatureNationally

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PosterBackgroundGenerate

args.description: Parameters for EventAccessGrant

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AccessGrantCreate

args.name: input

args.description: Parameters for PostHideFromEvent

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueRegularNightHide

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for TribeIdentify

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatPromptsImport

Times move with the lineup (from the event's start, or the night's 6am); people and tracks map by id, else by name, else are left out, and warnings say which.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for LineupImport

fields.name: importListings
fields.description: Imports an uploaded listings file whose dry run is done, on the worker, as the dry run said: adds its venues and events, locales, People or social profiles, by its kind.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ListingsImport

args.name: input

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for TriviaSetImport

args.description: Parameters for VenueDeviceIssue

args.description: Parameters for TipPay

fields.name: pinChatMessage
fields.description: Pins an announcement under its chat room's title, replacing the one pinned there, or unpins it.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatMessagePin

fields.name: promoteChatLink
fields.description: Makes a venue's or an event's community chat link (a Discord, Matrix or IRC SocialLink) its own chat account. A venue's room then goes to that community instead of the audience's: a Discord invite becomes the server it's for. The account starts as a link-out; map the room to a channel (setChatChannel) and add a bot and the bridge (connectChat with venueId) as with any venue account. An event's becomes where the apps send people from the event (Event.chatCommunity). One with an account on another provider moves to this one.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatLinkPromote

fields.name: promoteRoomFile
fields.description: Posts a picture shared in a back-of-house room to its venue's public chat, as a photo with a caption and alt text (RoomPromotion). The room keeps its copy, marked promoted. The venue and admins post any picture as the venue; talent post a picture they shared, as one of their listings in the room (asPersonId).

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for RoomFilePromote

fields.name: pushEventToEventbrite
fields.description: Puts an event created in the console on Eventbrite now: a draft the first time, updated after that. With publish, it goes public too, once it has tickets on Eventbrite; the organizer's "Add to Facebook" setting on Eventbrite then puts it on their Facebook Page.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EventPushToEventbrite

fields.name: putHostOn
fields.description: Puts someone on as the host right now, in one step (HostOnNow): they join the lineup's hosts and go on stage, an event not started yet starts now, the show starts, and the venue's chat lists them at once. Name the lineup, or the venue (and event) for its default zone's.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for LineupHostPutOn

fields.name: queueVenueMusicServiceTrack
fields.description: Queues a song on the venue's Soundtrack sound zone playing now: a track staff picked (Venue.music.serviceTracks), or the best match for a song request. It plays after the song on now, or at once with immediate. Whoever runs the show, as for controlVenueMusic; never guests.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueMusicServiceTrackQueue

fields.name: recordAgeCheckPurchase
fields.description: Records the one-time age check purchase: StoreKit's signed transaction (Transaction.jwsRepresentation) on iOS, or Play Billing's purchase token and product ID on Android. Buy it with the member's ID as the account token (appAccountToken / obfuscatedAccountId). The API checks it with the store; afterwards the check is READY to start.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AgeCheckPurchaseRecord

fields.name: recordCardViews
fields.description: Records that promoted cards were on screen. Send only the cards actually shown.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for CardViewsRecord

fields.name: recordIdCheck
fields.description: Logs an ID the door couldn't scan (a passport, a foreign licence, a worn barcode), typed in by hand: its kind, number, expiry, name and birth date, as Utah requires (R82-4-101(3)(b)).

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for IdCheckRecord

fields.name: recordVenueStorePurchase
fields.description: Records a Velvet subscription bought or restored in the app: StoreKit's signed transaction (Transaction.jwsRepresentation) on iOS, Play Billing's purchase token on Android. The purchase must have been made with the venue's ID as its account token (appAccountToken / obfuscatedAccountId). The API checks it with the store; the venue comes back with its subscription refreshed.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueStorePurchaseRecord

fields.name: refreshAgeCheck
fields.description: Asks the age check company how the check they are waiting on went, for an app that came back from the check before the company's own answer arrived.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AgeCheckRefresh

fields.name: refreshInstagram
fields.description: Queues an import of a linked public Instagram profile.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for InstagramRefresh

fields.name: refreshPage
fields.description: Refreshes a venue's or person's Page from Facebook now instead of waiting for the scheduled refresh.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PageRefresh

fields.name: refundAdmission
fields.description: Refunds a cover. Buyers can refund their own until it's scanned at the door or the night is over; the venue's door staff and the audience's admins can refund any paid cover.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AdmissionRefund

fields.name: refundTip
fields.description: Refunds a paid tip from the performer's account. Admins only.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for TipRefund

fields.name: registerDevice
fields.description: Stores the push notification token for the device this session signed in on.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for DeviceRegister

fields.name: registerStaffLiveActivity
fields.description: Hands over a staff Live Activity's push token, so the API keeps it up to date while the app is closed: a new song, a moved queue, a bingo number drawn on another phone. iOS ends an activity within 12 hours, and the token stops being pushed then. On Android, the FCM token of the app showing the music or bingo notification.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for StaffLiveActivityRegister

fields.name: registerVenueDisplay
fields.description: A venue device registers a screen it drives and gets its display back, made the first time with the default ranking (a game or sing-along when one runs, else the board with the venue's posters and photos). An Apple TV calls it with no key for itself; a Mac once per screen with its key. Calling it again also marks the screen as seen.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueDisplayRegister

fields.name: remindSafetyAlert
fields.description: Sends your open safety alert again: staff on shift hear it again, and the venue's managers too. At most every 30 seconds.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for SafetyAlertRemind

fields.name: removeAppReviewCode
fields.description: Removes an App Review code linked to its own test account (AppReviewCode), or an earlier main code (the demo venue's), which stops working; the account stays.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AppReviewCodeRemove

fields.name: removeArticle
fields.description: Takes an article down as the audience (moderation), whatever its publication says, or puts it back (removed: false).

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ArticleRemove

fields.name: removeChatMessage
fields.description: Removes a message from its chat room. Everyone in the room stops seeing it at once; the console's transcript keeps it, marked removed, with the reason.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatMessageRemove

fields.name: removeChatPrompt
fields.description: Removes one of an event's chat prompts, for whoever runs the night: one still to show comes off the list (skipping it); one that's up is taken out of the room for everyone, and stays in the list as shown (takenDown), so it never goes up again.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatPromptRemove

fields.name: removeEventPhoto
fields.description: Removes a photo you took with the app's camera (addEventPhoto), from every page it was on.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EventPhotoRemove

fields.name: removeLocaleGuide
fields.description: Unlinks a local guide from its locale, so research no longer reads it.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for LocaleGuideRemove

fields.name: removeMyChatMessage
fields.description: Removes one of your own messages from its chat room. Everyone in the room stops seeing it at once.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatMessageRemoveOwn

fields.name: removePersonHeadshot
fields.description: Takes a headshot out of a performer's headshots. Posters already made keep it.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PersonHeadshotRemove

fields.name: removePersonaMember
fields.description: Takes someone out of a persona; members can take themselves out.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PersonaMemberRemove

fields.name: removePostComment
fields.description: Removes a comment on a post: its author's own, or any on a post for whoever manages its poster (the venue's managers, the talent listing's) and admins.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PostCommentRemove

fields.name: removePosterArt
fields.description: Removes a generated background or a commissioned poster. Posters already downloaded keep it.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PosterArtRemove

fields.name: removePublicationAd
fields.description: Takes a publication's ad down at once (it stops showing), whatever the publication says, or puts it back. The note is shown to the publication. A paid ad taken down is the publication's to refund its sponsor: it was its sale.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PublicationAdRemove

fields.name: removeReview
fields.description: Takes a review down; its author still sees it.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ReviewRemove

fields.name: removeRoomChecklistItem
fields.description: Removes an item from a room's checklist. Whoever added it may, and the venue and admins.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for RoomChecklistItemRemove

fields.name: removeRoomFile
fields.description: Deletes a file shared in a room, and its stored copy. Its uploader may, and the venue's managers and admins.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for RoomFileRemove

fields.name: removeRoomMessage
fields.description: Removes something said or posted in a room, with its replies and the files it shared. Its writer may, and the venue's managers and admins.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for RoomMessageRemove

fields.name: removeVenueBannerPhoto
fields.description: Takes an image out of a venue's banner images.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueBannerPhotoRemove

fields.name: removeVenueSlide
fields.description: Removes a slide from its slideshow. Screens fixed on it move through the slideshow instead.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueSlideRemove

fields.name: renewEvaluationLease
fields.description: Keeps the lease on work this worker is still on for another ten minutes.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EvaluationLeaseRenew

fields.name: renewOnboardingInvite
fields.description: Gives a pending or expired invite a new code and expiry; the old code stops working.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for OnboardingInviteRenew

fields.name: reorderLineup
fields.description: Puts a night's lineups in a new running order. Each entry stays on its own lineup (the venue's or an event's): only the order within each changes.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for LineupReorder

fields.name: reorderVenueBannerPhotos
fields.description: Puts a venue's banner images in this order. Name each of them once.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueBannerPhotosReorder

fields.name: reorderVenueSlides
fields.description: Puts a slideshow's slides in this order. Name each of them once.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueSlidesReorder

fields.name: reportChatMessage
fields.description: Reports a message in a venue's or locale's chat room to the audience's admins, who see it in the console's Reports queue at once and can remove it or ban the sender. Optionally blocks the sender too. A post as the venue or as a person can be reported like any other; blocking ignores it, since a listing has no sender to block. Same as reportContent with MESSAGE.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatMessageReport

fields.name: reportContent
fields.description: Reports a message, person, venue, ping, photo, post or comment to the audience's admins, who see it in the console's Reports queue at once. Optionally blocks the person responsible, when there is one: a message's sender (not for posts as the venue or a person), the person themself, a ping's sender, a comment's author.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ContentReport

fields.name: reportEventPhoto
fields.description: Reports a photographer's photo, for example a photo of yourself you want taken down. It's hidden at once, until the audience's admins look at it in the console's Reports queue; the photographer sees it was reported. reportContent with PHOTO does the same.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EventPhotoReport

fields.name: reportEventPlaylistTracks
fields.description: Reports the songs of an event's Spotify playlist as the calling Velvet device's own Spotify lists them, for a playlist AudienceKit cannot read itself: they become the event lineup's playlist segment (Event.playlist.tracks) and their lyric timing is fetched ahead of the night. Only a venue device with the music permission, for an event at its venue with a Spotify playlist.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ReportEventPlaylistTracks

fields.name: reportKaraokeQueue
fields.description: Reports the singer queue the calling device's venue shows in its karaoke app (KaraFun), for Event.karaoke.queue and Venue.karaoke.queue. Only a Velvet device whose code has the music permission, at a venue connected to KaraFun. A report goes stale after three minutes, so send it again while the app runs; an empty list clears the queue.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for KaraokeQueueReport

fields.name: reportLocation
fields.description: Records the user's position and returns the venue they're in, or what's near them.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for LocationReport

fields.name: reportLyricTiming
fields.description: Reports when each lyric line of a Spotify track is sung, and each syllable when it was timed that finely, without the words, for other venues' sing-along screens (Venue.music.lyricTimings). Only a Velvet device whose code has the music permission. Kept unless a timing that matched more lines from the audio is already there; syllables join the kept lines either way. Words given with it are kept encrypted when they fit the kept lines.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for LyricTimingReport

fields.name: reportNowPlaying
fields.description: Reports the song playing at the calling device's venue, for Venue.music.nowPlaying. Only a Velvet device whose code has the music permission. A report goes stale after two minutes, so send it again while the song plays; stopped: true clears it.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for NowPlayingReport

fields.name: reportSafetyShiftPresence
fields.description: Reports whether this device is inside a venue, for a safety shift that follows the venue's geofence.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for SafetyShiftPresenceReport

fields.name: reportStoreCountry
fields.description: Tells the API which country the signed-in user's app store is in (StoreKit's Storefront.countryCode, Play Billing's BillingConfig.countryCode), so it knows whether they need proof of age (the United Kingdom and Australia). Send it at sign-in. A country that needs one sticks; reporting another later changes nothing.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for StoreCountryReport

fields.name: reportTrackFeatures
fields.description: Reports what a recording sounds and feels like for Diverse Shuffle (Venue.music.diverseShuffle): vectors and attributes per dimension, lyric chunks and a lyric summary. Only a venue device with the music permission. Replaces only what it names.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for TrackFeaturesReport

fields.name: reportVenueOpen
fields.description: Says a venue reported closed is still open. A reviewer decides; the venue is back in tonight's views sooner when enough people (or its staff) say so.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueOpenReport

fields.name: requestSong
fields.description: Asks for a song, or signs up to sing one, in a venue's chat room. Everyone in the room sees the REQUEST line, and the host finds it in the queue. Refused while the venue is not taking requests of that kind (see Venue.requests for why).

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for SongRequestCreate

fields.name: researchListing
fields.description: Add with AI (doc/LISTING_RESEARCH.md): starts researching a person or venue from a few words, like "Spokane Pride", on the audience’s AI provider with its web search. Read the draft with Audience.listingResearch(id) until it’s DONE (usually under a minute), check it, then save it with createPerson or createVenue. Nothing is saved by this.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ResearchListing

fields.name: resetAppReview
fields.description: Does what `rake app_review:reset` does: resets the sandbox reviewer account, refreshes the demo venue and its sample nights, sets the review code and turns App Review on for Hot Mess and AudienceKit Demo (AppReviewState). It also resets the second reviewer, banned from one Hot Mess venue, with its own code (AppReviewCode). Platform administrators only.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AppReviewReset

fields.name: resetAudienceInvite
fields.description: Makes a new invite link for the audience. The old link stops working; people who already joined keep their listings.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AudienceInviteReset

fields.name: resolveContentReport
fields.description: Resolves a report in the audience's Reports queue, and the other open reports on the same thing. removeContent takes the content down first (removes the message, hides the photo, ends the ping); banUser bans the person responsible from the audience, as banAudienceMember does.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ContentReportResolve

fields.name: respondToFriendRequest
fields.description: Answers a friend request someone sent the viewer. Accepting makes them friends and tells the sender; "Not now" hides it and tells nobody.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for FriendRequestRespond

fields.name: respondToPersonaInvite
fields.description: Accepts or declines your invite into a persona.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PersonaInviteRespond

fields.name: restoreVenueDuplicate
fields.description: Undoes a "not a duplicate" call (dismissVenueDuplicate): the pair is suggested again while it still looks the same, and the dismissal stays in the history. Administrators only.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueDuplicateRestore

fields.name: revealTriviaRound
fields.description: Takes the room's call and shows the answer now, without waiting for voting to close. On a segment that reveals answers at the end, closes its voting instead: the answer shows when the segment ends.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for TriviaRoundReveal

fields.name: reviewEntityLink
fields.description: Confirms a link (LINKED: it shows) or turns it down (REJECTED: it never shows, and matching never suggests it again). Admins only.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EntityLinkReview

fields.name: reviewFlaggedMessage
fields.description: Settles a message the AI host flagged in your venue's room (Venue.flaggedMessages): dismiss it, remove it, warn the sender privately, cool them down for a few minutes, escalate it to the audience's admins, or ban them from the venue. Messages from the people who run the room can only be dismissed or escalated.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for FlaggedMessageReview

fields.name: reviewPublicationAd
fields.description: Approves a publication's ad waiting in soapbox.adReviewQueue (it runs from its first day), or turns it down with a note the publication sees. Turned down, the publication can change it and send it again.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PublicationAdReview

fields.name: reviewSafetyAlert
fields.description: Records what the audience's team decided about a flagged safety alert, which takes it out of the needs-a-look list. BLOCKED also bans the sender from the audience, as banAudienceMember would.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for SafetyAlertReview

fields.name: revokeEventAccess
fields.description: Takes back an event granted to a talent listing (grantEventAccess). Whoever may grant it revokes it.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EventAccessRevoke

fields.name: revokeObjectAccess
fields.description: Revokes an access grant from a subject.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AccessGrantRevoke

fields.name: revokeOnboardingInvite
fields.description: Stops a pending invite working. Access it already granted stays; remove that on the access list.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for OnboardingInviteRevoke

fields.name: revokeServiceToken
fields.description: Revokes a service token. It stops signing in at once; a JWT it already traded for lasts at most an hour.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ServiceTokenRevoke

fields.name: revokeVenueDevice
fields.description: Revokes a venue device and its unused code.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueDeviceRevoke

fields.name: rsvpEvent
fields.description: Sets the user's RSVP to an event in AudienceKit. It isn't sent to Facebook, which no longer lets apps RSVP for people. A ticket holder stays going whatever they answer.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EventRSVP

fields.name: saveAdAccount
fields.description: Opens, pauses or closes a persona's ad account: an active one makes it an advertiser.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AdAccountSave

fields.name: saveArticle
fields.description: Writes a new draft for a publication (publicationId) or changes an article (id). Publishing is setArticleStatus's. A reader's op-ed is the publication's to edit once it accepts it.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ArticleSave

fields.name: saveCommunityResource
fields.description: Adds a community resource (food, shelter, health, crisis, DV) to a locale, or changes one.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for CommunityResourceSave

fields.name: saveCredit
fields.description: Adds a persona's credit on an event, venue, article, media title or locale, or changes one.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for CreditSave

fields.name: saveDigitalFlyer
fields.description: Adds a digital flyer for a locale (or the whole audience), or changes one. It shows to everyone in the city while it is live; its tone and category follow from its tags.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for DigitalFlyerSave

fields.name: saveMediaClip
fields.description: Adds a song from one of the audience's media titles to its clips, or changes one.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for MediaClipSave

fields.name: saveMediaEpisodes
fields.description: Adds or changes a series' episodes for one season, matched by number. With replace, the season's other episodes are deleted.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for MediaEpisodesSave

fields.name: saveMediaItem
fields.description: Adds an item (a recording, live version, music video, scene, podcast episode, ...) to the audience's media, or changes one. Link a variant to its song with songId.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for MediaItemSave

fields.name: saveMediaPlaylist
fields.description: Adds a playlist (an album, a Spotify playlist, a podcast, a curated list) to the audience's media, or changes one. Fill it with syncMediaPlaylist or setMediaPlaylistItems.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for MediaPlaylistSave

fields.name: saveMediaSong
fields.description: Adds a song to the audience's media, or changes one. Its variants link to it (saveMediaItem).

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for MediaSongSave

fields.name: saveMediaTitle
fields.description: Adds a film or television title, by its IMDb id or link, to the audience's media, or changes one.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for MediaTitleSave

fields.name: savePersonOffice
fields.description: Records an office a person holds or is running for, or changes one (doc/plans/CIVIC_ORGANIZING_PLAN.md).

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PersonOfficeSave

fields.name: savePersonaMember
fields.description: Invites someone into a persona, or changes a member's role or title.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PersonaMemberSave

fields.name: savePromoPlacement
fields.description: Books a promoted, charity or announcement card into the apps' layouts, or changes one when id is given. Where it shows is contextual only: screens, locales, nights and venue or event tags.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PromoPlacementSave

fields.name: savePublication
fields.description: Starts publishing as a person listing you manage (personId), or changes a publication (id). A new publication waits for the audience to trust it unless an admin starts it. One an admin starts links out to the publisher's site (its feed) until its publisher runs it (doc/SOAPBOX.md).

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PublicationSave

fields.name: savePublicationAd
fields.description: Books a sponsor's ad on a publication's own articles (spot ARTICLE) or page (PUBLICATION), or changes one (id). New and changed ads wait for the audience's admins when the publication's ads need review (Publication.adsNeedReview). dryRun checks it without saving.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PublicationAdSave

fields.name: savePublicationRateSheet
fields.description: Sets a publication's public rate sheet: a flat weekly price and the number of sponsors that share each ad spot, never per view or tap, plus notes and a sales contact. Ads booked before keep their price.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PublicationRateSheetSave

fields.name: saveReview
fields.description: Writes or changes your review of a film, a show or an event; publish: true publishes it.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ReviewSave

fields.name: saveVenueDisplayGroup
fields.description: Makes a screen group at a venue (venueId), or changes one (id): its name and the one setup its screens show. Fields left out stay; a new group starts with the default ranking. Its screens follow within a second.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueDisplayGroupSave

fields.name: saveVenueMusicLicense
fields.description: Records a public performance license a venue holds, or changes one (with id): who grants it, its number, its term and what it covers (Venue.musicLicensing).

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueMusicLicenseSave

fields.name: saveVenueSlide
fields.description: Adds a slide to the end of a slideshow (slideshowId and kind), or changes one (id). A still is an uploaded image (photo) or an event's poster (eventId); a video is a file uploaded to the venue's room first (startRoomUpload, finishRoomUpload), named by roomFileId. Fields left out stay.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueSlideSave

fields.name: saveVenueSlideshow
fields.description: Makes a slideshow for a venue's screens (venueId), or renames one (id).

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueSlideshowSave

fields.name: saveWatchParty
fields.description: Adds a watch party on a film or series (one season or the whole run), or changes one.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for WatchPartySave

fields.name: scanAdmission
fields.description: Checks a pass's QR code at a venue's door. The first scan of a paid pass checks them in; later ones that night are re-entry.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AdmissionScan

fields.name: scanId
fields.description: Checks an ID at a venue's door from the barcode on its back (PDF417, as the camera read it): its age, expiry and whether the barcode is shaped like a real one. Logs only what the venue's jurisdiction lets the door keep, for as long as it may (doc/DOOR_ID_CHECKS.md).

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for IdCheckScan

fields.name: scanPairUpCode
fields.description: Scans a Quickie code. Your partner's confirms you met (both see You met!); someone else's gives the two of you a fresh topic instead. Anything else says why, without changing anything.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PairUpCodeScan

fields.name: seeSafetyAlert
fields.description: Records that this device opened a safety alert at its venue, so the guest knows someone saw it.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for SafetyAlertSee

fields.name: sendChatMessage
fields.description: Posts to a venue's or a locale's chat room, as the signed-in admin (STAFF), as the venue (VENUE) or as a person (HOST). Everyone in the room sees it at once. Admins post as any; venue listing managers only as their venue; talent as a person they manage, in the rooms of the venues and locales they're featured in or host events at (Person.chat.rooms), from anywhere: text, a PHOTO or one of their EVENTs.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatMessageSend

fields.name: sendFriendRequest
fields.description: Asks someone contact matching found to be friends, and pushes them. Asking someone who already asked the viewer accepts their request.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for FriendRequestSend

fields.name: sendMyChatMessage
fields.description: Says something in a chat room as yourself. The message reaches everyone following the room at once.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatMessageSendOwn

fields.name: sendPing
fields.description: Tells friends the signed-in user wants to go out tonight, naming venues or events, or neither.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PingSend

fields.name: sendPracticeSafetyAlert
fields.description: Sends a practice safety alert to your venue: the staff on shift hear it, marked as practice, and pick it up and close it as they would a real one. It never escalates, flags or reaches anyone else. While your practice alert there is still open, sending again returns it.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for SafetyAlertPractice

fields.name: sendPrivateChatMessage
fields.description: Says something in a Ping or Quickie chat you're in. Everyone else in it hears it on Subscription.privateChat; nobody hears what was said once the chat closes.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PrivateChatMessageSend

fields.name: sendRoomMessage
fields.description: Says something in a room, or posts there (kind POST, with a title, which can be pinned and replied to), sharing the files uploaded for it (startRoomUpload). Name the room, or the venue, event or locale whose back-of-house room it is.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for RoomMessageSend

fields.name: sendSafetyAlert
fields.description: Tells the staff on shift at the venue you're at that you feel unsafe (only while the app places you there). Where you are and what is going on are optional; send it first and add them after (updateSafetyAlert). While your alert there is open, sending again adds to it.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for SafetyAlertSend

fields.name: sendSafetyAlertMessage
fields.description: Sends a message in a safety alert's private thread: from the guest who sent it while it is open, or from staff at its venue. Never shown in venue chat.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for SafetyAlertMessageSend

fields.name: setAiCapability
fields.description: Selects a linked provider and model for a capability (or, where the capability allows it, a provider on AudienceKit's own key, metered). Omit provider to restore feature defaults.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AiCapabilitySet

fields.name: setArticleStatus
fields.description: Moves an article on (doc/SOAPBOX.md): SUBMIT for the audience's approval, PUBLISH (a trusted publication's managers, or admins approving it), UNPUBLISH, RETURN_TO_DRAFT, and ACCEPT_OP_ED or DECLINE_OP_ED for a reader's op-ed.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ArticleStatusSet

fields.name: setAudienceAdmin
fields.description: Makes a member one of the audience's admins, or not. Takes effect when they next sign in.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AudienceAdminSet

fields.name: setAudienceMusixmatchKey
fields.description: Keeps the audience's own Musixmatch API key, so its venues' sing-along screens use its lyrics rights before AudienceKit's, and checks what its plan allows (Audience.musixmatch). An empty key removes it.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AudienceMusixmatchKeySet

fields.name: setCalendarFeedVenue
fields.description: Follows a venue in the signed-in user's calendar subscription (doc/CALENDAR_SYNC.md), so every event there is in it, or stops following it. Makes the subscription on first ask.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for CalendarFeedVenueSet

fields.name: setChatChannel
fields.description: Makes a venue's or locale's room one of the chat provider's channels, e.g. a Discord channel, so the apps send people there. An empty channel clears it, and the room sends people to the invite.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatChannelSet

fields.name: setChatInitials
fields.description: Shows the signed-in user's initials in chat rooms instead of their photo, or their photo again.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatInitialsSet

fields.name: setContactMatchName
fields.description: Changes the first and last name friends match the viewer on. Their own codes follow at once.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ContactMatchNameSet

fields.name: setCoverNight
fields.description: Changes one night's cover at a venue whose door the caller works: another price, none, or other hours. It wins over the usual cover and over an event that night.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for CoverNightSet

fields.name: setDiscordApp
fields.description: Sets the audience's own Discord application: its client ID, client secret and bot token (Developer Portal: OAuth2 and Bot), stored encrypted. Omitted or null arguments keep their value; an empty string clears it. Clearing all three goes back to AudienceKit's bot for the next "Add bot".

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for DiscordAppSet

fields.name: setEventChatPrompts
fields.description: Changes an event's chat prompts (Event.chat): whether and when its room shows them, and the list itself. A list replaces the one it has, in its order; prompts already shown tonight stay as they were, whatever the list says. starterSet starts the list from one of Event.chat.starterSets.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EventChatPromptsSet

fields.name: setEventKaraoke
fields.description: Marks an event as a karaoke night, or not, and links it to the session singers join that night on its venue's karaoke partner. Without a session code of its own, a night uses its venue's standing one.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EventKaraokeSet

fields.name: setMarqueePosterApproved
fields.description: Approves one of the audience's standard TV posters, or holds it back so no venue's screens or picker show it. AudienceKit's own posters change only for AudienceKit administrators.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for MarqueePosterApprove

fields.name: setMediaPlaylistItems
fields.description: Sets a playlist's items, in order: items left out leave it. A series' episodes come from Films & TV.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for MediaPlaylistItemsSet

fields.name: setPairUpPush
fields.description: Turns Quickie pushes on or off for the signed-in user: when they are paired, revealed or met, and invites to join when someone at the venue they are at wants a Quickie. On until they turn it off. The app still shows Quickie while it is open.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PairUpPushSet

fields.name: setPersonHeadshotApproval
fields.description: Approves a headshot for posters, or takes the approval back. Approving once covers every poster.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PersonHeadshotApprovalSet

fields.name: setPersonHeadshotCutout
fields.description: Replaces a headshot's cut-out with one made by hand, or with none and retry asks the background-removal service again.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PersonHeadshotCutoutSet

fields.name: setPersonLocale
fields.description: Features a person in one of the audience's locales, or stops featuring them there.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PersonLocaleSet

fields.name: setPersonSquareLocation
fields.description: Picks which of a performer's Square locations their tips are paid to.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PersonSquareLocationSet

fields.name: setPersonVisibility
fields.description: Sets who sees a performer: PUBLIC (the whole internet) or COMMUNITY (signed in), as their default or, with eventId, on one of their events. Only the performer makes themselves PUBLIC; a platform admin may with their in-person consent, saying so in note.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PersonVisibilitySet

fields.name: setPromoRateClasses
fields.description: Sets where venues and cities sit on the public rate card: a venue's tier (small, mid, large) and a locale's city size (small, large). A venue buying its own promoted card pays that row's price. Null clears one back to the cheapest row. Placements already booked keep their price.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PromoRateClassesSet

fields.name: setPublicationTrust
fields.description: Sets how far the audience trusts a publication: TRUSTED publishes directly, PENDING needs each article approved, SUSPENDED stops it and hides what it published.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PublicationTrustSet

fields.name: setReadiness
fields.description: Says who is ready for a curtain call: the venue, a performer or someone on the support staff. The show runs on GO (advanceLineup waits for it unless forced).

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ReadinessSet

fields.name: setRecentChatPush
fields.description: Turns on or off pushes about new messages in chat rooms the signed-in user left in the last 30 minutes (at most one every 10 minutes per room). Off until they turn it on.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for RecentChatPushSet

fields.name: setRoomTrackNeeded
fields.description: Says whether an act on an event's lineup needs a track in the event's back-of-house room. Performers' acts need one unless someone says not; others don't unless someone says they do. The venue's managers and staff, admins, the event's hosts and the act's own people may (RoomAccess#trusted_with?).

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for RoomTrackNeededSet

fields.name: setSafetyShift
fields.description: Turns this device's safety alerts at a venue on or off, and sets the first name guests see when it picks one up.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for SafetyShiftSet

fields.name: setShowAtVenues
fields.description: Turns "Show me at venues" on or off for the signed-in user. Off takes effect at once: nobody sees which venue they are at or whether they are in a chat room, and they stop seeing that about everyone else too. On takes effect 14 days after they ask (`showsAtVenuesAt`), and turning it off again before then cancels the ask. Asking twice in six months files a report for the audience's admins.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ShowAtVenuesSet

fields.name: setSoapboxPublisherAds
fields.description: Sets whether Soapbox publishers sell ads on their own content in the audience's apps, and which of their ads its admins review first (soapbox.publisherAds).

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for SoapboxPublisherAdsSet

fields.name: setSongRequestState
fields.description: Moves a song request or karaoke signup along: UP calls it (playing now, or the singer is on, announced in the room; whatever was up goes back to QUEUED), DONE and SKIPPED finish it, QUEUED puts it back. For admins, the venue's managers and the host on now.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for SongRequestSetState

fields.name: setTestUser
fields.description: Marks someone as a test account, or not: their reports stay out of the open queues and their actions (pings, Quickie, chat, safety alerts) push only other test accounts. Platform admins mark anyone, an audience's admins their own members.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for TestUserSet

fields.name: setTribes
fields.description: Replaces the signed-in user's tribes here with these, for the picker's Done. Tribes they keep keep their privacy; new ones are private. Refused, changing nothing, past audience.tribeCap tribes.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for TribeSet

fields.name: setUpDiscordApp
fields.description: Sets the audience's own Discord application's Interactions Endpoint, Linked Roles Verification and Event Webhooks URLs to the API, and registers its linked roles (member, admin, days a member), through its bot token. Discord checks the endpoints answer before it saves them.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for DiscordAppSetUp

fields.name: setVenueMusixmatchKey
fields.description: Keeps a venue's own Musixmatch API key, so it brings its own lyrics rights, and checks what its plan allows (Venue.musixmatch). An empty key removes it.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueMusixmatchKeySet

fields.name: setVenueSquareLocation
fields.description: Picks which of the venue's Square locations its cover is paid to.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueSquareLocationSet

fields.name: sharePairUp
fields.description: Agrees to share your meeting in the venue's chat. Once both of you have, the venue posts your names (first name and last initial) and your topic.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PairUpShare

fields.name: shareSafetyAlertSupport
fields.description: Shares "Need support?" (crisis and support lines) with the guest who sent a safety alert at your venue, open or closed, with a note if you like.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for SafetyAlertSupportShare

fields.name: showEventPhoto
fields.description: Shows a hidden or reported photo in the apps again.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EventPhotoShow

fields.name: showMeInCredits
fields.description: Shows you in the credits of what your accepted suggestion added or changed, or stops showing you.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ShowMeInCredits

fields.name: showNextChatPrompt
fields.description: Puts an event's next chat prompt up in its venue's room now, pinned under the title, without waiting for the rotation: for whoever runs the night (Velvet, Backstage, Focus). It goes up even past the nightly cap, while an act is on, or with prompts off; the rotation counts on from it. Name the event (id), which must be on now, or the venue (venueId) for the latest event on there now with prompts left.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatPromptShowNext

fields.name: showPairUpCode
fields.description: A fresh QR code to show your partner once you both accept. It works once, only for them, and replaces the one you showed before.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PairUpCodeShow

fields.name: skipPairUp
fields.description: Skips the topic for a new one (both accept again), or the partner: both look for someone new and aren't paired together again tonight.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PairUpSkip

fields.name: startAgeCheck
fields.description: Opens an age check and answers where to send them. With no method, or DOCUMENT, it is the check they paid for; CARD is the free credit card check and needs no purchase. `url` is its hosted page (open it in an in-app browser), and `clientSecret` opens the same session in the company's own mobile SDK where the app has it. The answer arrives on its own; read `me.ageCheck` again, or call refreshAgeCheck when they come back.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AgeCheckStart

fields.name: startAiProviderSignIn
fields.description: Starts a single-use AI provider sign-in for this audience and admin.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AiProviderSignIn

fields.name: startBingoGame
fields.description: Starts a game of bingo at the venue, ending any still running; the venue's screens show its board.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for BingoGameStart

fields.name: startContactPhoneVerification
fields.description: Saves the name friends will match the viewer on and texts a six-digit code to their mobile number (verifyContactPhone). Up to five codes a day, 30 seconds apart.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ContactPhoneVerificationStart

fields.name: startDiscordBotInstall
fields.description: Returns Discord's page for adding the audience's bot (its own Discord application's, setDiscordApp, else AudienceKit's) to its server. Afterwards the browser comes back to returnTo with discord_bot_result=connected, or discord_bot_error.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for DiscordBotInstallStart

fields.name: startMaintenanceRun
fields.description: Starts a maintenance operation on the worker. On an audience’s endpoint it runs for that audience; on the tenants endpoint it runs for audienceId, or platform-wide without one.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for MaintenanceRunStart

fields.name: startPrivacyPass
fields.description: Starts paying for a privacy pass: no paid cards and every optional use of their data off, for the audience's privacy pass days. Returns a Checkout page to open in the browser. Nothing renews.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PrivacyPassStart

fields.name: startRoomUpload
fields.description: Starts uploading a file to a room: PUT its bytes to `uploadUrl` within 30 minutes, with the same Content-Type (or, from a browser, POST them in `partSize` parts to `partsPath`), then confirm it (finishRoomUpload) and share it (sendRoomMessage fileIds). Sound, pictures, video and documents (PDF, text, office files, zip), up to 200 MB. A file not shared within a day is deleted. Name the room, or the venue, event or locale whose back-of-house room it is.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for RoomUploadStart

fields.name: startTip
fields.description: Starts tipping a performer in the app, through their own Stripe or Square account (the IN_APP option of their tipping mixin). Stripe: finish with Stripe's payment sheet (paymentIntentClientSecret, on their account stripeAccountId, with publishableKey), then call confirmTip. Square: make a payment token with Square's In-App Payments SDK (squareApplicationId, squareLocationId), then call payTip with it. Asking again for the same amount soon after returns the same tip. A tip to a Soapbox publication (publicationId) can read it without ads, so it is paid on the web instead: open checkoutUrl in the browser (US storefronts only), then call confirmTip when the reader comes back.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for TipStart

fields.name: startVenueSubscription
fields.description: Starts a venue's Velvet subscription on the web: open checkoutUrl in a browser sheet. Stripe Checkout comes back to the API, which records it and returns to the app at audiencekit-velvet://billing?status=subscribed (or canceled). A first subscription starts with a free trial.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueSubscriptionCheckout

fields.name: submitContribution
fields.description: Suggests a missing venue or event, a correction, a closure, a tag or a performer for the audience's listings. A reviewer decides; nothing changes until they approve. Local rules are corrected with submitLocalRulesCorrection, by venue staff.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ContributionSubmit

fields.name: submitLocalRulesCorrection
fields.description: Suggests a correction to a venue's local rules, as its verified staff. A reviewer decides; age policy and licence class changes need a link or photo, and the public licence record outranks the venue's claim.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for LocalRulesCorrectionSubmit

fields.name: submitOpEd
fields.description: Sends a publication an op-ed from the apps, under the signed-in reader's name. The publication takes it (then edits and publishes it, bylined to the writer) or declines it with a note; Audience.soapbox.myOpEds shows where each stands (doc/SOAPBOX.md).

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for OpEdSubmit

fields.name: syncChat
fields.description: Saves the channels and members the chat bot sees in the audience's (or a venue's own) Discord server, and the one it migrated from.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatSync

fields.name: syncEventSetList
fields.description: Mirrors the event's set list (the Spotify songs on its lineup, in running order) to a public Spotify playlist in the venue's connected Spotify account, made the first time. People open it in their own Spotify (Event.setList). After the first time, it follows the lineup by itself. Refused when the venue has no Spotify account connected, the lineup has no Spotify songs, or the connection needs to be made again to write playlists.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for SyncEventSetList

fields.name: syncMediaPlaylist
fields.description: Reads a Spotify playlist's or album's songs (a playlist with the audience's connected Spotify account), or a podcast's feed, into the playlist, in order. Spotify tracks link to the song they perform when one clearly fits.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for MediaPlaylistSync

fields.name: syncSpotifyQueue
fields.description: Compares or matches the calling Mac's Spotify queue with the songs not yet played in tonight's playlist segment of the lineup, with the venue's connected Spotify account. Only a Velvet device whose code has the music permission. For personal demo and rehearsal on the account holder's own Spotify, not for playing to a room: show notice beside it.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for SyncSpotifyQueue

fields.name: unbanAudienceMember

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AudienceMemberUnban

fields.name: unblockUser

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for BlockedUserRemove

fields.name: undoBingoCall

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for BingoCallUndo

fields.name: ungroupLocale

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for LocaleUngroup

fields.name: unlinkAiProvider

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AiProviderLinkDelete

fields.name: unlinkVenue

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueUnlink

fields.name: unlinkVenueMusicService

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueMusicServiceUnlink

args.description: Parameters for AiWorkerUpdate

fields.name: updateAppearance

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AppearanceUpdate

fields.name: updateArbiterPrompt
fields.description: Sets an audience's own text for one of Arbiter's prompts, or (a blank body) goes back to the default.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ArbiterPromptUpdate

fields.name: updateArbiterSettings
fields.description: Sets how Arbiter, the Mac moderator and AI host, judges and hosts for an audience. Omitted or null arguments keep their value; guardThresholds and ruleThresholds replace the whole list given.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ArbiterSettingsUpdate

fields.name: updateAudience

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AudienceUpdate

fields.name: updateAudienceAdvertising

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AudienceAdvertisingUpdate

fields.name: updateAudiencePrivacyPass
fields.description: Sets the audience's privacy pass: its price in US cents (null sells none) and how many days it lasts. Passes already bought keep their dates.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AudiencePrivacyPassUpdate

fields.name: updateAudienceTheme
fields.description: Replaces an audience's theme: its design system preset, tagline, color overrides, fonts and logos.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AudienceThemeUpdate

fields.name: updateCardArrangement
fields.description: Sets the audience's own order for one screen's cards in the apps: the content cards' order, which it leaves out, and where its announcements and promo slots go. The apps get it with their next layout, no release needed. reset goes back to the platform default.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for CardArrangementUpdate

fields.name: updateChatMessage
fields.description: Edits an announcement or special: its title, its body, or when a special ends. An endsAt of now or earlier ends the special at once.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatMessageUpdate

fields.name: updateEvent
fields.description: Changes one of the audience's events.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EventUpdate

fields.name: updateEventSeries
fields.description: Changes one of the audience's recurring series. Its upcoming occurrences follow, except ones edited on their own.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EventSeriesUpdate

fields.name: updateLineup
fields.description: Changes a lineup's hosts, billing, scene setting or (a zone's night) hours.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for LineupUpdate

fields.description: Ticks, unticks, removes, puts back or rewords a lineup entry's task. Fields left out aren't changed. Anyone working the show ticks; whoever may change the lineup removes, puts back and rewords (only an entry's own task has words of its own).

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for LineupTaskUpdate

fields.name: updateLocale

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for LocaleUpdate

fields.name: updatePerson

args.description: Parameters for PersonUpdate

args.description: Parameters for PhotographerUpdate

fields.name: updatePost
fields.description: Changes a venue's or a person's post. Fields left out aren't changed.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PostUpdate

fields.name: updatePrivacyChoices
fields.description: Sets the signed-in member's privacy choices in this audience. Arguments left out stay as they are.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PrivacyChoicesUpdate

fields.name: updatePromoCardCopy
fields.description: Replaces the audience's own words for promoted cards: category names and descriptions ("Cards you see") and the badges (Promoted, Charity, Announcement). args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PromoCardCopyUpdate

fields.name: updatePublicationMedia

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PublicationMediaUpdate

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for RoomMessageUpdate

args.description: Parameters for SafetyAlertUpdate

fields.name: updateStaffAssignment

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for StaffAssignmentUpdate

fields.name: updateStageZone

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for StageZoneUpdate

fields.name: updateTag
fields.description: Renames or recolors one of the audience's tags, everywhere it is applied.

args.description: Parameters for TagUpdate

fields.name: updateTaskTemplate

args.description: Parameters for TaskTemplateUpdate

args.description: Parameters for TicketingAccountUpdate

fields.name: updateVenue

args.description: Parameters for VenueUpdate

fields.name: updateVenueCover

args.description: Parameters for VenueCoverUpdate

fields.name: chatModeration
fields.description: The audience's moderation feed, for its remote moderation provider: every event after `after`, then each new one as it happens.

args.description: The cursor of the last event handled; without it, every kept event is sent.

fields.name: chatRooms
fields.description: Follows the audience's chat rooms, as `chat { rooms }` lists them: a room, fresh, whenever someone joins or leaves it or its messages change (posted, edited, removed, cleared). Admins hear every room; venue listing managers their own venues. Nothing arrives on subscribing.

fields.name: decisionQueue
fields.description: The decision queue as it changes: a decision added for a person, decided, or set aside to wait on someone else. Nothing arrives on subscribing; read `decisions` first.

fields.name: door
fields.description: Follows a venue's door for tonight: DoorOpened, then every cover that's paid, scanned in or refunded, with fresh totals. For whoever may work the door: its admins, its listing managers, and a venue device with `door`.

args.name: venueId
args.description: The venue.

fields.name: edgeChanged
fields.description: Follows a record's lists (a venue's events, an event's appearances): an event whenever a member joins, leaves or changes, carrying the member as you may read it. Name an `edge` to hear about one list only.

args.name: edge
args.description: Only this list, by its association's name (`events`); every list without it.

args.name: id
args.description: The record's ID, as node(id:) takes it.

fields.name: evaluationQueue
fields.description: Tells a worker device that work of the types it follows is waiting on the evaluation queue: once on subscribing when any is, then as work is queued, and each minute while it waits.

args.name: evaluationTypes
args.description: Only these types, of those the token holds; every one by default.

fields.name: localeChat
fields.description: Follows a locale's chat room, for people out in the locale and not at a venue: ChatJoined, then everything the room says and who comes and goes, until ChatLeft. The room's admins join from anywhere.

args.name: localeId
args.description: The locale.

args.name: watch
args.description: Follows the room without being in it: no presence, so nobody sees the subscriber as in chat. For a glimpse of the room, like ChatPeek.

fields.name: myNotifications
fields.description: Your notifications while the app is open, in concert with your devices' push service: each push sent to you (a friend's ping, a reply) arrives here too, with the `notificationId` the device copy carries, so the app shows it itself and skips the system banner. Nothing arrives on subscribing.

fields.name: nodeChanged
fields.description: Follows a record by its ID: an event whenever it changes or is deleted, carrying the record as you may read it then, so you select what you show and need no refetch. Any Node you can see; nothing arrives until it changes.

args.name: id
args.description: The record's ID, as node(id:) takes it.

fields.name: privateChat
fields.description: New lines in any Ping or Quickie chat you are in, and chats closing, while the app is open. Nothing arrives on subscribing: read a chat's earlier lines from Ping.chat or PairUpMatch.chat.

fields.name: room
fields.description: Follows a room you're in: an event whenever something said or posted there is added, changed (edited, pinned, a reply or file added) or removed, while you're still in it. Nothing arrives on subscribing.

args.name: id
args.description: The room's UUID.

fields.name: venueChat
fields.description: Follows a venue's chat room: ChatJoined, then everything the room says and who comes and goes, until ChatLeft. Open to people at the venue, and to the room's admins from anywhere.

args.name: venueId
args.description: The venue.

args.name: watch
args.description: Follows the room without being in it: no presence, so nobody sees the subscriber as in chat. For a glimpse of the room, like ChatPeek.

fields.name: venueDisplay

args.name: id

For the venue's Mac (a venue device with music) to act on, and for whoever runs the show (the venue, the hosts of the event on now) to show.

enumValues.name: NONE
enumValues.description: Never subscribed, or checkout never finished.

enumValues.name: TRIALING
enumValues.description: In its free trial.

enumValues.name: ACTIVE
enumValues.description: Paying.

enumValues.name: PAST_DUE
enumValues.description: A payment failed; everything works while the store retries.

enumValues.name: LAPSED
enumValues.description: Payment retries ran out or it was paused: the tools are locked.

enumValues.name: CANCELED
enumValues.description: The subscription ended.

fields.name: accessGrants
fields.description: Permissions granted on this venue.

fields.name: activity
fields.description: How busy it is right now, approximately. Admins and its managers only.

fields.name: adultVenue
fields.description: Whether it is flagged for adult content: its posters and TV marquee may use the adult-venue slogan lines.

fields.name: allCredits
fields.description: Every credit on it, shown or not, for its admins.

fields.name: archived
fields.description: Whether it closed for good: kept for its history, listed nowhere.

fields.name: articles
fields.description: The instance's IArticles mixin. Left out of the schema where its module isn't installed.

fields.name: audiences
fields.description: The audiences it appears in: none for a venue started on its own in Velvet, else any number.

fields.name: bannerPhotos
fields.description: Its banner images, in the order the apps rotate through.

fields.name: bannerUrl
fields.description: Its Google place photo when available, else its first banner image, own photo or Facebook Page's cover photo.

fields.name: bingo
fields.description: The instance's IVenueBingo mixin. Left out of the schema where its module isn't installed.

fields.name: canSendSafetyAlert
fields.description: Whether the viewer can send a safety alert here now (sendSafetyAlert): the app places them at the venue. The apps show "Get help" only then.

fields.name: chat
fields.description: The instance's IVenueChat mixin. Left out of the schema where its module isn't installed.

fields.name: chatRetentionMinutes
fields.description: How many minutes its chat room shows a message before it expires: its own window, else the default.

fields.name: chatRetentionOverridden
fields.description: Whether the venue set its own chat retention window.

fields.name: contributionQuestions
fields.description: Suggestions a reviewer asked the venue's staff to confirm (answerSubmission). Who suggested them is never shown.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: When the record was created.

fields.name: credits
fields.description: Its credits that everyone sees, original source first.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Its public description.

fields.name: displayGroups
fields.description: Its screen groups (such as Bar TVs): sets of screens that show the same thing. Its managers and devices only.

fields.name: displays
fields.description: Its screens (Apple TVs, Mac screens, Chromecasts) and what each shows. Its managers and devices only.

fields.name: distance
fields.description: Metres from the position the venues were looked up near.

fields.name: distanceTolerance
fields.description: Distance in metres counted as being at the venue.

fields.name: editHistory
fields.description: Changes to its details, newest first: what, when and through what.

args.name: limit
args.description: At most this many (up to 200).

fields.name: events
fields.description: The instance's IVenueEvents mixin. Left out of the schema where its module isn't installed.

fields.name: facets
fields.description: The keys of the facets switched on for it, e.g. karaoke, in key order: each is a tag the system keeps (Tag.facet) and turns on the edges of the mixins declaring it (@mixin(tag:)). Only those whose module is installed.

fields.name: flaggedMessages
fields.description: Messages in its room from the last two days that the audience's AI host flagged or ruled something about, newest first, for its staff to settle (reviewFlaggedMessage): the simple version of the admins' message analyses. Its managers, Velvet devices with moderation and the audience's admins.
